description: Generate a Playwright test suite: smoke checks that hold on any site (status, title, console errors, failed requests, broken links, axe accessibility) plus your steps as real code

actions.description: Steps: actions goto /path · click <sel> · fill <sel> <value> · select <sel> <value> · check <sel> · hover <sel> · press <key> · wait <sel>; assertions visible <sel> · hidden <sel> · text <sel> <text> · url <part> · title <text> · count <sel> <n> · value <sel> <value>

assertions.description: Assertions run after the actions (see actions for the syntax)

auth.description: Log in once in a setup project and reuse the session

mobile.description: Also run the smoke checks on an iPhone 13 viewport

name: generate_playwright_test
